question:
In the following question, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3699c8a359a263c0b3f09b32ab88ff2aba0cb78661790d0d904a5486cd727c9.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• In the 1st step, an arc(outward facing) is added at the end of the element.
 
• In the 2nd step, the element(line with outward facing arc) is added. The 1st step and 2nd step is again followed until the final image is obtained.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76bc62b6f3e41f1076e0eda3b8cea42d9f4d910e66abc1cef1aca8f65968062c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
